title: PackLab: reproducible Percus--Yevick correlations for hard-sphere mixtures
description: PackLab is a Python package for unit-aware Percus--Yevick pair correlations and structure factors of multicomponent hard-sphere mixtures, with complementary Random Sequential Addition and Metropolis Monte Carlo workflows backed by native C++ kernels.
